name: Display layout
author: zerwiz
description: Arrange monitors (position, mode, scale, rotation, enabled, main screen) from a drag-and-drop panel, like the Ubuntu Displays settings, save the layout to Hyprland's monitors.lua, and adjust monitor colour and hardware brightness/contrast.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: drag monitors to reposition with edge snapping, pick resolution/scale/rotation, choose the main screen, set hardware brightness/contrast over DDC/CI, adjust the Hyprland colour pipeline, and save the layout.
